The '''Cosia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cosia/Legends|Cosia]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Cosian/Legends|Cosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />
